product.title: Unique Secluded Sunset In Moab: Canyonlands by 4x4 & Hike

description.text: In Canyonlands National Park, join a private small-group sunset outing that pairs a short bumpy 4x4 ride on Long Canyon Road with a half-mile scramble hike to a secluded vista. Start time shifts with sunset so picture stops land in warm evening light away from crowded overlooks. Stops include Long Canyon Road, Canyonlands National Park, Secluded sunset overlook. The private format keeps pacing flexible for photos and short walks. Ideal for visitors basing in Moab who want a guided Canyonlands National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or backcountry routes on their own.
